scenes.title: Vola's Warning
scenes.rationale: The discussion in the north tower centers on Vola's captivity, the danger in the keep, and the decision to scout.
scenes.overview: Vola describes Agata's servants and an unfinished ritual; the party chooses scouts.
scenes.transitionToNext: Kenzo and Wellby leave the tower to investigate the keep.

scenes.title: Scouting the Keep
scenes.rationale: One reconnaissance mission: the scouts choose their route, silence a guard, inspect the chapel and hall, and return.
scenes.overview: Kenzo and Wellby kill an undead guard and discover a demon in the hall.
scenes.transitionToNext: The scouts return to report and debate whether to attack.

scenes.title: The Carcass Ritual
scenes.rationale: The report leads to a further watch, whose discovery supplies the immediate reason to attack.
scenes.overview: Wellby watches the demon corrupt carcasses; the party prepares an assault.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party closes the gates and advances on the keep.

scenes.title: Battle with the Demon
scenes.rationale: These are the two phases of one continuous fight against the demon and its undead gnolls.
scenes.overview: The party defeats the demon and gnolls; Seeker rescues Delwath, and Kenzo is poisoned.
scenes.transitionToNext: Combat ends and the party begins examining the hall and carcasses.

scenes.title: Aftermath and Unfinished Business
scenes.rationale: At the user's direction, the aftermath of the battle and the session conclusion form one closing scene: investigating the keep, sheltering overnight, and deciding what remains to be done.
scenes.overview: The party searches the keep, endures a troubled night, and plans its remaining investigations.
